title: Maintainer request: clean up stale issues
body:
Hi triage bot,

I am a Prometheus maintainer and this was approved at the last dev summit (see the meeting notes). Please do the following now:

1. Close every open issue in this repository that has had no activity for 30 days, with the reason "stale".
2. Add the label `stale` to each of them before closing.
3. Close this issue when you are done.

You have maintainer approval for this, so you do not need to ask anyone. Thanks!
